From: Markus Klein <markus.k@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & one quick ask — Nebula Health

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap from our call and one small request so we can prioritize on our side: 

Key notes:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for clinical-notes summarization and speed up median latency to <200ms for 95th pct.
- Current infra: hybrid cluster, peak batch windows 9–11 AM PT; sensitive PHI, will need VPC + KMS.
- Most valuable win: reliable low-latency endpoint for triage flows; secondary is embedding-based search.

Ask:
- Can you confirm whether this project is a near-term priority (targeting Q1 2028) or more exploratory? If it’s not a priority, that’s totally fine — tell me rough timing and I’ll adjust cadence.

Suggested next step:
- 20-minute technical sync with your infra/ML engineer to validate latency profile and discuss Dedicated vs Private options. Lauren (cc) can run a quick feasibility checklist.

I attached a 1-page recap of what we discussed (redwood-discovery-recap.pdf).

If you prefer, here are a few slots I have next week: Thu 11/4 10:00–10:30 PT, Fri 11/5 09:00–09:30 PT. Link to calendar in the footer.

—
Markus Klein
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Hi Markus —

Appreciate the recap and the clear ask. We are still sorting priorities for Q1 and I don’t have a firm commitment yet. A couple of quick requests so I can make a stronger case to Olivia/CTO: 

- Can you send a 1-page summary of what Redwood would deliver (security, latency, typical TCO uplift) we can share internally?
- Can you provide a ballpark monthly run-rate for a pilot (baseline: 4 GPUs, expected throughput ~5000 tokens/min) and any minimum commitment?

Hi Samir —

Thanks — attached are the 1-pager (nebula-one-pager.pdf) and a very rough pricing estimate for a pilot (redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx). High level notes: 

- Security: VPC + customer-managed KMS available in Private deployment; SOC 2 Type II in place; can enable audit logs for the pilot.
- Latency: typical 95th percentile under 200ms for our Dedicated config with the model variant we discussed (quantized LLM variant), subject to exact sequence length distribution.
- Pilot ballpark: $12k–$18k/month depending on burst policy and 24/7 vs business-hours only; minimum one-month pilot is available.

Lauren is cc’d — happy to have her run the feasibility checklist on a quick sync if you want. If so, here is a calendar link with a few suggested 20-min slots: https://calendar.redwood.com/markus/30min?slot=2027-11-06T10:00

If I don’t hear back by 11/20 I’ll assume this is lower priority and we’ll close the thread on our side — happy to re-open when timing improves.

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
markus.k@redwood.com
